consumer: the owner's ad account (replace with the real one)
notes: A short vertical ad in which a human presenter speaks every beat on camera: the h3 talk chain (README, H3 talking shots). Each beat is one MiniMax H3 take in ComfyUI from the scene still, the hero, the face close-up and the presenter's reference voice; the edit lays the screen capture, the price card, a still and the end card over parts of the beats while the voice goes on. Set active to true once the character bible (with voice.ref_wav and the face and scene stills approved), the facts file, the capture and its boxes exist, and the graph's license fields are filled in. It is a commercial template (an ad for a paid service), so the facts step refuses it until the graph's wrapper says commercial_ok: true, which only its owner sets after reading the model license (the example graph says false).
